text.en: Cat owners emphasize that home visits keep their pets relaxed and happy in their familiar environment. Sitters spend quality time playing with the cats and patiently accommodate nervous or shy personalities. Even when pets require medication or fall ill while owners are travelling, clients report that their companions receive devoted attention.

Clients describe Alice and her team of cat sitters as reliable, caring, and true feline enthusiasts. Reviewers appreciate pre-visits arranged to introduce sitters to their pets before departure. Cat parents feel complete peace of mind knowing their homes and animals are in trustworthy hands during holidays and work trips.

title.en: Daily photo updates and video logs

text.en: Owners highlight the excellent communication provided throughout their absence, with daily photos and video updates sent after every visit. The client app allows owners to upload detailed routines, dietary preferences, and alarm codes. Several reviewers note that prompt updates significantly ease travel anxiety.

q.en: Do cat sitters send updates while owners are away?

a.en: Yes, clients regularly receive daily photos and video logs after each visit to monitor their cats' wellbeing.

q.en: Can sitters conduct an introductory visit before service starts?

a.en: Yes, sitters arrange an initial meeting in advance so cats can become familiar with them before visits commence.

q.en: Are the sitters able to care for shy or nervous cats?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that sitters are patient and experienced in accommodating anxious felines at their own pace.

q.en: How do clients share care instructions with Maow Care?

a.en: Owners submit feeding instructions, medication requirements, and home access details via an online portal.
